headline: Trump defends easing sanctions on Russia

scenes.name: DONALD TRUMP
scenes.text: [serious] President Trump is defending his decision to ease sanctions on Russia.

scenes.title: HOW IT HAPPENED
scenes.text: On October ninth, he cut a deal to buy Russian diesel. Friday, he waived tough new sanctions passed by Congress.

scenes.title: U.S. DIESEL PRICE
scenes.text: Diesel now averages six dollars eighteen a gallon, up from three forty eight in January.

scenes.name: VLADIMIR PUTIN
scenes.text: Trump says more pressure could push Putin away from peace talks, and he hinted a hostage deal is in play.

scenes.name: SEN. THOM TILLIS
scenes.text: Republican senator Thom Tillis called the move beyond irresponsible.

scenes.title: Worth it for cheaper diesel?
scenes.text: [curious] Will cheaper diesel be worth it? Tell us in the comments.
[warmly] Follow The 30s Brief, for your daily news in thirty seconds.
